tools.name: calculator_describe
tools.description: The inputs this calculator takes (with units, ranges and defaults), the outputs it returns, and the assumptions and tables behind it.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Run the MVL calculator calculator: Your share of the distribution, after the liquidator's fee; Your capital gain; CGT if the distribution is paid by 5 April 2027; CGT if the distribution is paid from 6 April 2027. Missing inputs fall back to their documented defaults.

retained.description: Cash left in the company after its debts and Corporation Tax

baseCost.description: What you paid for your shares

otherIncome.description: Your other income in the tax year of the distribution

badr.description: Do you expect to qualify for Business Asset Disposal Relief?

badrUsed.description: Gains you have already claimed BADR on

paid.description: When will the liquidator pay your distribution?

similar.description: Will you carry on a similar trade or activity within 2 years?

tools.name: enquiry_describe
tools.description: Read first. States plainly what submit_enquiry does on MVL Calculator: it starts an enquiry with MVL Calculator, whose team reads it and replies directly. Nothing is bought, ordered or paid; no quote is guaranteed; it is free. Also returns who receives the details, the consent wording, and how the person confirms.

tools.name: enquiry_fields
tools.description: Every field of the MVL Calculator enquiry: key, label, type, whether required, help text and the allowed options where there are any. Pass answers to submit_enquiry keyed by field key.

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Submits an enquiry to MVL Calculator: NOT a purchase, NOT a guaranteed quote. Step 1: call with the answers (keyed by field key from enquiry_fields) and consent=true; it validates and returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token; show the person the summary and the consent line. Step 2: only if the person agrees, call again with the same answers, consent=true and the confirmation token; the enquiry is then submitted, and the person receives an email with a link they must click before the MVL Calculator team sees it. Consent means the person has read and agreed to: "Joe, who runs this site, will reply to me himself. No firm receives my details."

answers.description: the person's answers, keyed by field key

consent.description: true only when the person has agreed to: Joe, who runs this site, will reply to me himself. No firm receives my details.

confirmation.description: the confirmation token from step 1, after the person has approved the summary
